name: navigator-session-isolation-decision
body:
Decision record for the navigator-session-isolation change-set.

SOURCE. The distributed `codebase-navigator` keeps RESUMING reviewer and implementer subagents via the `task` tool (passing `task_id`); resumed context windows fill up and break. Isolation was the design. The only acceptable resume is the tight hand-back loop: an implementer returns to the navigator for a scan/verify/`apg_review_action`, and the navigator resumes that SAME session only to finish the SAME task (mark done). Resuming to start a NEW task is forbidden, and reviewer sessions are never resumed.

ROOT CAUSE (verified against the branch graph + the file). `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (File node, 594 lines, `code_type = docs`) carries only one resume instruction — the "Implementation flow" bullet at lines ~492-493: "Resume the same session, only to mark done (apg_plan_done + apg_plan_note), then end it." Nothing states that each dispatch is a fresh ISOLATED session, nor that resuming is bounded to that one hand-back, so the navigator freely carries `task_id` into new tasks and into reviewer sessions. The plan-authoring "re-dispatch" language (~lines 403-435) and the "Feedback routing (coordinator-mediated)" section (~lines 523-548) must stay consistent with "a re-dispatch is a FRESH dispatch, not a resume".

DOMAIN MODEL DECISION [autonomous]. Added a NEW sibling entity `domain.entity.subagent-session-isolation` rather than updating the live contract entity `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence`. Reason: the concerns are distinct — the cadence entity is the ordering discipline for mutating the plan under the staleness guard (commit → quick verify → scan → resume to mark done), and its wording ("one task per implementer session", "resumes the session only to mark done") is already consistent with isolation; the new concern is the session-lifecycle policy (fresh dispatch, bounded hand-back, never a reviewer, never a new task) which the cadence does not state. The new entity is bare (no `contains` parent), mirroring its sibling `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence`. Editing the cadence body was considered and rejected as churn that would couple this change-set's domain node to the existing `navigator-task-cadence` requirement without a coherence gain.

CONSTRAINT DECISION [autonomous]. Authored a NEW law `requirements.constraint.subagent-sessions-isolated` (attaches-to the new requirement) and LEFT the existing `requirements.constraint.navigator-cadence-stated` intact: the old law governs the cadence ordering, the new one governs session isolation. They are additive, not overlapping.

SPINE. Added `requirements.requirement.navigator-session-isolation` (feature `navigator-session-isolation`) under the existing coordinator user `requirements.user.navigator-agent` (no new user — the navigator is the actor whose `task` usage this bounds). Domain: the new sibling entity above. Solution: REUSED `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (already 1:1 with the prompt file, already implemented-by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, and under `solution.container.opencode-suite`), and added the NEW narrow `solution.component.navigator-isolation-coherence-test` under `solution.container.scanner-cli` (the root-crate test surface, where the sibling test-bearing component `solution.component.distributed-agent-install` also lives), implemented-by the existing test fn `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose`. Edges: user ⊃ requirement —drives→ entity —realised-by→ both components —implemented-by→ the prompt file and the test fn.

COVERAGE DECISION [autonomous]. Did NOT add the test fn to `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`'s implemented-by set; created the narrow test component instead. The two edited files (prompt + test) each get a component whose implemented-by set is exactly that one artifact, so the verify gate's derived solution coverage (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check`) maps 1:1 to the change-set and no component's set spans an untouched file — the same narrow-owner reasoning recorded in `solution.note.agent-roster-narrow-owners` and `requirements.note.navigator-task-cadence-decision`. Adding the test fn to the prompt component would falsify its "implemented-by is exactly the prompt file" body and couple the test to the existing cadence requirement.

IMPLEMENTED-BY RESOLUTION. Both targets resolve in the branch graph — `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (File, `docs`) and `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (Function, `tests/main_e2e.rs:2148-2222`, `code_type = test`). No planned Implementation node is needed: the test edit is a `modifies` over an existing FQN.

SCOPE. Product-source prompt + test only; no binary behaviour change. No other `opencode-suite/agents/*` file is edited. The repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts and are never edited.
